name: pack_uv
description: Shelf-pack the box UVs so every cube gets its own region of the texture. REQUIRED before texturing a box_uv model (GeckoLib/Bedrock): newly created cubes all sit at uv_offset [0,0] and otherwise paint onto the same pixels. Re-run after adding or resizing cubes. Auto-grows the texture (preserving paint) if the layout overflows.

auto_resize.description: Grow the texture if packing overflows (default true).
